reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic! I took my Spitz there and the grooming was impeccable. I highly recommend it!

We just returned from the HITOG grooming salon for a scheduled appointment. Upon seeing my dog, an American Bulldog, the groomer in charge of my adorable pup told me curtly, "I don't take dogs like that!" This very unpleasant person, in addition to refusing to groom my dog, doesn't she even like dogs? Why did her coworker accept the appointment? This behavior astounds me! What discrimination!

A very warm welcome! Excellent work, even with a challenging dog. You can feel their passion for animals and their primary concern for their well-being. I highly recommend them!
